metadata.description: Community index of Claude skills for scientific work. Every entry is pinned to an exact commit and checked automatically.

plugins.name: szl-evidence-skills
plugins.description: TypeSafe Jev as an optional, fail-closed second reader for evidence triage; decisions that carry their own evidence.

plugins.name: szl-science-skills
plugins.description: Eight integrated workbench skills at the current source preview; retained evidence and dependency invalidation. Offline by default.

plugins.name: szl-frontier-flotation
plugins.description: MODELED flotation rank and abstaining unitless selectivity prior before the bench. Never recovery. No hosted service.

plugins.name: szl-science-multiplicity-skills
plugins.description: One bounded offline complete-family multiplicity audit. Holm FWER or declared-assumption BH FDR; HOLD if any planned result is missing. Plan hash is not preregistration.

plugins.name: szl-science-assay-skills
plugins.description: One bounded offline assay-run audit for a researcher-declared increasing linear calibration, blank, QC and sample uncertainty disclosures. Synthetic fixtures only; not method validation or clinical qualification.

plugins.name: szl-science-replay-skills
plugins.description: Three bounded offline replay skills: pin and rerun a CSV mean, render and inspect a declared CSV-to-SVG figure, or align CSV exports under declared specimen IDs and unit conversions. No supplied code, network or credentials.

plugins.name: szl-paper-evidence-skills
plugins.description: One offline PDF evidence locator skill: pin original and extracted bytes, match complete table-cell or figure-caption text, and require human visual review. No credentials required.

plugins.name: szl-science-ledger-skills
plugins.description: Nineteen core science audit tools including outcome preservation, release continuity and offline skill update review. Source preview; no host registration or scientific qualification claimed.

plugins.name: szl-science-design-skills
plugins.description: One bounded offline prospective experiment-contract draft: expose missing controls, units, falsifier, harm limit and cheapest decisive measurement. No preregistration, execution, inference or credentials.

plugins.name: szl-science-change-impact-skills
plugins.description: One offline research change-impact skill: compare retained dependency graphs and supplied artifact digests, preserve withdrawn dependencies and required claims, and plan reassessment. No experiment execution, services or credentials.

plugins.name: szl-science-uncertainty-skills
plugins.description: One bounded offline first-order uncertainty-lineage skill for declared arithmetic graphs and complete input correlations. Exact decimal correlation PSD check; synthetic fixtures only. No unit, coverage, scientific-truth, network or credential verification.

plugins.name: szl-science-rare-disease-replay-skills
plugins.description: One synthetic-only offline rare-disease evidence timeline replay with pinned HPO/ClinVar-shaped snapshots and source/provenance ablations. Always HOLD; no diagnosis, model use, network or credentials.
